EventVOTranscription
Ship DescriptionYamato-class ship number three – Shinano.
Self IntroductionPlay‌I am called Shinano, aircraft carrier of the Sakura Empire. I was to stand beside Yamato during that war, yet in the end... Alas, there is impermanence in all things, and nothing became of this one's life... May your guidance lead my fate to a different outcome...[EN 1]
AcquisitionPlay‌This sensation... is that of reality... Was it you who awoke this one from her long slumber? Such is the inevitability of fate... Please allow Shinano, third ship of the Yamato-class, to guide you forward upon the right path.[EN 2]
LoginPlay‌Nnnh... You have returned. Long, eternal, has this one's wait been...
DetailsPlay‌Mmh... True strength can shatter the chains of fate... or is this but the moon's reflection within the water... Mm...[EN 3]
Secretary (Idle) 1Play‌Even the most beautiful flower is transient, to be scattered into the wind... But, 'tis better to bloom for but a moment than to wither eternally upon the vine.
Secretary (Idle) 2Play‌Do you wish to rest within this one's bosom? ...Yes, just as the little destroyers do...[EN 4]
Secretary (Idle) 3Play‌I would like to experience all this port has to offer... should it be possible...
Secretary (Idle) 4Play‌I have left the report here... Hmm... There are many errors? ...'twould seem that hasty deadlines are not this one's strong suit...[EN 5]
Secretary (Idle) 5Play‌Vrooom... Zzzzzz... Oh... Did I hit you by mistake? ...Sincerest apologies...
Secretary (Touch)Play‌Mmmm... Hm? ...I dozed off again? ...Sincerest apologies...
Secretary (Special Touch)Play‌You musn't... Not there... Nnh...
Secretary (Headpat)Play‌Aah... My ears are sensitive...
TaskPlay‌This task... can it be completed in time...?[EN 6]
Task CompletePlay‌As long as you are here, there is nothing that cannot be accomplished...
MailPlay‌Dismiss not the letters bearing distant thoughts...
Return From MissionPlay‌Nnnh... Your safe return... pleases me...
CommissionPlay‌Mmmm... The girls on commission are returning now... 'twould behoove you to forget them not...
StrengtheningPlay‌May this not end in futility...[EN 7]
Start MissionPlay‌Though fate has been written, I shall fight until my soul's duty has been fulfilled...
MVPPlay‌Is this... my power...?
DefeatPlay‌Apologies... I have failed to meet your expectations...[EN 8]
Skill ActivationPlay‌Your fate... has been sealed...
Low HPPlay‌...I shall not retreat...
Affinity (Disappointed)Play‌From here, this one sees not any light...
Affinity (Stranger)Play‌To carry the burden of great expectations, yet unable to demonstrate the power to meet them... Such is fate's mockery of this one's existence...[EN 9]
Affinity (Friendly)Play‌To see destiny, yet to be unable to change it; or to be ignorant to the turning of fate... Which is the greater misfortune?
Affinity (Like)Play‌Long has this one dreamt... Tragic dreams that one wishes to never recall... Blissful dreams from which one hopes to never wake from... Even reality itself seems like just another dream.. Commander, is this truly reality, or yet another illusion?
Affinity (Love)Play‌I once lamented my inability to shift the hand of fate... But now, and forever... as long as you are here...
PresentPlay‌This one shall cherish your gift...
PledgePlay‌The memories forged at this port... have brought me great joy... Alas, from now on... I shall cherish my time with you through fates both joyful and painful... through weal and woe alike...
Gift Description Valentine's 2021(The gentle sound of her relaxed breathing, a soft sensation on your skin, a sweet smell in the air - Shinano was asleep on your bed by your side, with sweets resting on her chest. She knew. That when you woke up, she would be the first thing you noticed, and that you would accept her love for you.)
Gift Description Valentine's 2022(Her gentle fragrance wafts into your nostrils upon the morning breeze as you are roused from your slumber. The two of you are tightly embracing, her tails covering you instead of your blanket. You seem to have been using her as your pillow after falling asleep. She smiles, aware that you've seen her, having seen the wonderful day you are about to have.)
Gift Description Valentine's 2023(She dreams of a life with no duty, living every day like any average girl in love. Is that the dream desired by a lovestruck girl, or is it one of the fragments of which she speaks? Whatever the case, the chocolate was made as she bathed in this bittersweet moment in time. All that is certain is a future where it is eaten with you—)
Gift Description Valentine's 2024(It is a winter's night. Shinano is deep into a visit to dreamland, her body resting against yours. The light from the fireplace casts a faint shadow on the wall – a shadow of you, huddled together. The tails gently swaying at her feet speak to the loveliness of her dream. Be it in the waking world or the sleeping one, as long as you are by her side, she is happy.)
Gift Description Valentine's 2025(You're awakened by the embrace of a soft, warm tail. The first things you see are Shinano's sleepy eyes, as rich and sweet as chocolate. As you see yourself reflected in them, you realize that she was enjoying sweet dreams of you. However, this very real moment is more blissful than any dream.)
  1. ↑ Shinano's refit into a very large "Support Carrier" was never completed. She was ambushed and sunk by the US submarine Archerfish during her first and only voyage to Kure Naval Base.
  2. ↑ Shinano's wreck remains undiscovered to this day...
  3. ↑ Due to several design flaws, inherent in every Yamato-Class ship, Shinano's effectiveness and impact as a "Heavy Armor Support Carrier" were rather doubtful.
  4. ↑ Shinano was escorted by Isokaze, Yukikaze, and Hamakaze during her first and last voyage to Kure Naval Base.
  5. ↑ Some of Shinano's very important damage control equipment couldn't be installed in time due to her hasten up departure on November 28 in 1944.
  6. ↑ A reference to her rather troublesome refitting into a Support Carrier which took over 4 years and couldn't be finished in the end due to hasty decisions from the Navy General Staff.
  7. ↑ Could be a reference to her very short career of only 10 days in total.
  8. ↑ Poor damage control and insufficient torpedo protection doomed Shinano. She sunk 7 hours after getting hit by 4 torpedos from the US submarine Archerfish.
  9. ↑ After the catastrophic loss of Japan's carrier divisions during the Battle of Midway, the Imperial Japanese Navy expected Shinano to fill in as a "Heavy Armor Support Carrier" that could support other CVs.

Dreams of the Hazy Moon

EventVOTranscription
Ship DescriptionThe moonlight dims beneath hazy clouds, and the lights of the night sky begin to shine... The moon, and this sake, are both intoxicating... Will you not enjoy this fine evening with me...?

LoginPlay‌The shimmering of the countless stars, the dancing lights of the banquet... This night... has only just begin... Zzzzz...
DetailsPlay‌Through the sojourn of the stars through the sky, through the waxing and waning of moons, fate remains immutable... In contrast, mortal dreams and realities alike seem like fleeting illusions...
Secretary (Idle) 1Play‌Being able to enjoy tonight's banquet thusly... fills one with apprehension that this... may be yet another dream...
Secretary (Idle) 2Play‌Though I have long been the plaything of fate, it still allowed me to meet you... How strange and whimsical a thing it must be...
Secretary (Idle) 3Play‌Western spirits are a new experience for this one... Even this trifling amount... has already... gone to my head...
Secretary (Touch)Play‌Beauteous is the moon tonight... Are you in agreement...?

Ship Description大和级三番舰—鵗
Third of the Yamato Class - Shinano.
Self IntroductionPlay‌妾身乃是重樱航母、信浓。原本当与鲸并肩，为重樱燃尽此身。然而最终却落得那般结局，世事无常，不外如是…而此次，妾身相信，有汝在，定然会有截然不同的结果——
This one is a carrier of the Sakura Empire, Shinano. This one was supposed to be side by side with Yamato, and to put my entire body for the Sakura Empire. However in the end this one ended up in that state, nothing in the world is destined, and that is how it is... but this time, This one believes, with you, the destined could end up with a completely different.
AcquisitionPlay‌这种感觉，并非在梦中…将妾身自沉睡中唤醒的，是汝？此亦命运的必然…大和级三号舰、鵗，让妾身为汝指引前进的正道吧。
This feeling, is not one feels of being in a dream... the one, that awakens this one from sleep is... you? This must inevitably be fate... Third of the Yamato Class, Shinano, let this one guide your path to the right one.
LoginPlay‌欢迎回来，妾身已等候汝多时了。
Welcome back, this one has waited for you for many hours.
DetailsPlay‌Zzzzz…真正的强大，足以挣脱命运的束缚…然而真的是那样吗…？
Zzzz... true strength, is enough to free fate from it's restraints... but is that really how it is...?
Secretary (Idle) 1Play‌美好的事物总是短暂，不过，有过一瞬的盛放，总好过默默无闻的凋零吧…
Wonderful things are always fleeting, but, blooming for an instant, is still better than a withering obscurity... right...
Secretary (Idle) 2Play‌指挥官，累了的话，要在我怀里睡一会吗？就如诸多重樱驱逐舰们都喜欢做的那般——
Commander, if you are tired, do you want to rest within my embrace? Just like how many members of the Sakura Empire Fleet likes as well--
Secretary (Idle) 3Play‌港区里有许多妾身未曾见识过的新鲜事物，有机会的话真想一一尝试看看…
There are lots of fresh and new things in the docks that this one has never seen, if there is an opportunity --- I truly want to try them out...
Secretary (Idle) 4Play‌汝托付于妾身的报告书在此…错误很多？…看来赶工也不是个好事…
The records that this one has handed you is there... there are lots of mistakes? ...Looks like rushing work is not a good thing as well.
Secretary (Idle) 5Play‌之字…嗯…啊，刚才不小心撞上汝了吗？抱歉…
"Zigzag"... mm... ah did this one bump into you by accident? My apologies...[CN 1]
Secretary (Touch)Play‌Zzzzzz…啊…妾身又睡着了吗？…非常抱歉…
Zzzzz... ah... did this one fell asleep again? ... this one is very apologetic...
Secretary (Special Touch)Play‌在这里…不可以…
Here... is not allowed...
Secretary (Headpat)Play‌指、指挥官，耳朵有点…
C-Commander, the ears are a little...
TaskPlay‌任务…能及时完成吗？
Missions... can it be completed in time..?
Task CompletePlay‌果然有汝在，没有什么是做不到的。
As expected with this one around, there is nothing that cannot be done...
MailPlay‌信件承载着来自远方的思念，万不可轻视…
Letters carry with them the intent from far away, you should never dismiss them...
Return From MissionPlay‌Zzzz…这次…也平安回来了，…
Zzzz... this time... one is back safely as well...
CommissionPlay‌Zzzzz…万不可…忘记那些默默付出之人，前往…迎接她们吧
Zzzzz... that is never allowed... to forget those that serve and sacrifice quietly, onwards... welcome them back.
StrengtheningPlay‌但愿这一切不会成为无用功…
Let us hope all of this will not be in vain...
Start MissionPlay‌胜负，皆为命定。至少…让我等竭尽全力——
Victory or defeat, is never predestined. At least... let this one put in my all-
MVPPlay‌这便是，妾身的力量…？
So this is... this one's power?
DefeatPlay‌抱歉，是妾身辜负了诸位……
My apologies, it is this one who implicated every one else....
Skill ActivationPlay‌已经看到了，汝等破灭的命运——
I have already seen it, the fate that is your destruction-
Low HPPlay‌妾身…不会就此退缩！
This one... will not shrink away from just this!
Affinity (Disappointed)Play‌在汝身旁，妾身看不到任何的光芒…
With you by my side, this one cannot see any glimpse of light...
Affinity (Stranger)Play‌承载了诸多期待与瞩目，却无法展现出与之相符的实力，这便是命运对妾身的嘲弄吗…
Carrying the expectations and gaze of everyone, but being unable to show and display strength that is equivalent, is this how fate wishes to mock me huh...
Affinity (Friendly)Play‌知晓命运，却无力改变；与一无所知，亦不知改变，究竟何者更加不幸呢…
Knowing destiny, but being unable to change it; as compared to; knowing nothing, and being unable to change it, in the end... which is more unfortunate...
Affinity (Like)Play‌妾身…一直在做着各种梦，悲伤的令人不忍回忆的梦，幸福的令人不想醒来的梦…甚至现实于妾身，亦如梦幻一般…指挥官，汝…究竟是现实，亦或是梦幻？
This one... has always seen various dreams, dreams that are so saddening that makes one not wish to revisit them, happy dreams that makes one not wish to wake up.... even this reality with you, is similar to that of one... Commander, you... are you real, or a dream?
Affinity (Love)Play‌妾身曾为缠绕于身的诸多“命中注定的无可奈何”而哀叹不已…而如今，只要在这里，只要与汝在一起，妾身便觉得，无论何种命运，皆不足为惧了——
This one had once lamented being entangled by the multitude of helplessness of being unable to change the destined... but now, as long as this one is here, and with you, this one feels that, regardless of what fate awaits, this one will not be afraid any more-
PresentPlay‌汝赠予之物，妾身自会珍重……
PledgePlay‌回想在此港区与汝经历之种种，皆是令人不禁微笑的美好回忆…是汝为妾身带来了截然不同的生活。从今往后，妾身会与汝一同，直面各种命运，无论幸或不幸——
Looking back at the many experiences that one has at the docks, multitude of them are wonderful memories that one would smile at without thinking... it is you who brought this brand new life to this one. From now on, this one will be one with you, facing various destiny head on, whether in good times or bad-
Gift Description Valentine's 2022（一早的清风，和随风传来的她的香味让你从睡梦中醒来——你们紧紧相拥，几条尾巴代替被子覆盖在身上。看来是被睡着后的她直接当做抱枕了。她知道你察觉到了她的存在，也知道你们将度过幸福的一天——）
Gift Description Valentine's 2023（做了一个梦，一个没有任何责任和义务，过着平凡的生活，一个像是会普通地恋爱的少女的梦。这是心爱的她所希望的梦，还是她言语中的"碎片"呢——这就是她边细品着那幸福而又甜蜜酸涩的一刻，边准备的巧克力吧。真实可信的，是将要一起享用这份巧克力的未来ーー）
Gift Description Valentine's 2024（冬夜的壁炉前映照出一双依偎的身影，她的尾巴在你腿边轻轻摇晃着。你知道，这是她心情愉悦的体现，即便她现在仍在梦中，但只要在你身边，她永远会为此感到安心和幸福。）
Gift Description Valentine's 2025（在尾巴温暖柔软的触感中，你睁开眼，视线正好与刚刚睡醒的她朦胧相对。那双眼中，她对你那如同巧克力一般甜美浓郁的爱意轻轻地包裹着你的倒影，你知道她刚从一个有你的幸福梦境中醒来。而迎接着她的，是比梦境还要美好的现实。）

Gift Description Valentine's 2025（暖かく柔らかなシッポに包まれ目覚めしあなたを迎えるのは、まだ目覚めにほど遠い信濃のうつろなる瞳。まるでチョコのように濃厚で甘美な瞳に揺蕩うあなたの姿から、彼女が今しがたまであなたとの仲睦まじき夢を観ていたと知る。夢から覚めし今この時間、二人を迎えるは甘き夢以上に愛しき現実なり――）

幻夢の絡繰 / Visions of Fantasy

EventVOTranscription
Ship Description光華閃き、ゆらりと動く幻夢の如く……汝のために作り出した夢に歓迎申す。須臾に姿を顕にする奇術…気になりや？
AcquisitionPlay‌光華閃き、ゆらりと動く幻夢の如く……汝のために作り出した夢に歓迎申す。須臾に姿を顕にする奇術…気になりや？
LoginPlay‌汝の到来に歓迎申す……此の洞天に心行けば、しばし滞在することもできよう……無論、妾はここで、汝と相伴す――
DetailsPlay‌此の夢を作りし理由を知りたい…？信濃はただ、汝と良き夢に浸りて、共に驚喜と幸福を興じたく……
Secretary (Idle) 1Play‌準備する時間が短く、尻尾の手入れが出来ておらず、少々乱れてしまい……どうか、気にせぬよう
Secretary (Idle) 2Play‌硝子のハコ、思いのほか狭し、些か窮屈なれど……見栄えは損なわれておらぬ…
Secretary (Idle) 3Play‌艶しく舞う幻夢の灯火、汝から投げられた熱き視線……汝への情念を、抑えきれぬ……
Secretary (Idle) 4Play‌斯様なる手振りが、歓喜の意を伝達できると……汝にはしかと伝わっている？汝に面した、妾の想いを…
Secretary (Touch)Play‌汝は…このハコを開けたい、と……？
Secretary (Special Touch)Play‌ん……汝の温度を信濃、感じ取れて申す…もしやこれが汝の奇術……？
Secretary (Headpat)Play‌ん…？夢の境界では信濃、眠りに落ちぬ……
Return From MissionPlay‌信濃が披露した奇術を、もう一度ご覧に……？汝の疲れを癒せるなら信濃、全力を尽くそう……
MVPPlay‌嗚呼、奇術の披露が、いと完璧に……
DefeatPlay‌縹緲たる夢は、いつかは消える定め……
Affinity (Love)Play‌如何に絢爛豪華なれど、奇術も須臾の驚嘆に消えゆく定め……されど一芸を幻夢に封ずれば、その神秘も永遠になろう……汝が望めば、この洞天に入り…妾もまた、幻夢にて汝に相伴す……

EventVOTranscription
Ship Descriptionふぅ……共にこの珍妙な酒を楽しむと約束したのに、つい飲み耽けて……残されたのは唇に何滴か…汝も…楽しむ…？
AcquisitionPlay‌ふぅ……共にこの珍妙な酒を楽しむと約束したのに、つい飲み耽けて……残されたのは唇に何滴か…汝も…楽しむ…？
LoginPlay‌この酒を共に口にすれば、汝と五感を共にし、知覚情念が溶け合う……嗚呼、言の葉を綴れぬほど心地よく………
Secretary (Idle) 1Play‌未曾有の妙境……汝…半歩進み、妾と寝床を共にして…夢を織りなしてくれるか…？
Secretary (Idle) 2Play‌ふぅ……今は眠る時に非ず…汝がくれたそよ風の如き感触を、ゆるりと味わい申す……
Secretary (Idle) 3Play‌酔いは回り、感情も高ぶり……心から湧き出る歓喜の情欲は…妾のものにして、また汝のものとも……
